decoder: the paper's simple ridge: one ridge per receptive-field group, 100 ms of summed spike counts -> 13 x 13 0.75-degree patch (opponent space, two-gain calibration), fold that holds the photograph out
choice: per step: the ridge window nearest the step in the same presentation (within 6 bins), and of the receptive fields decodable in it, the one with the most spikes; -1 where the ridge has no decoder (session or window)
metric: error: displayed 8-bit RGB MSE, decoded vs photograph at the same 169 sample positions (clicks only)
